name: FM lead

beschreibung.text: Digital FM lead: sine carrier with a 1:2 modulator whose index jumps at the attack and settles, velocity sets the bite.

notiz: Source rule: recipe card `lead.fm`, Reid [B2] part 13. Measured by `tests/rezepte.rs`, not yet heard. Manifest character words outside the vocabulary: digital (as clean), harsh (as aggressive). Manifest use words outside the vocabulary: melody (as drop).
